hooks.comment: Blocks a dispatched worker from stopping with uncommitted or unstaged work: the second net behind 'commit before your final message' (defaults/procedures.md), not the durability mechanism itself, since this hook fires only on a clean stop (Law 8). Exit code 2 blocks the stop and shows the message to the worker. KYO-17: `kyo check-clean` excludes exactly the paths `check-branch` forbids, reading both from one constant (contracts.GUARDED_BRANCH_DIRS), so the two checks cannot contradict each other. KYO-54: it reads the code repository, the worktree the worker is in, which under the split layout is not the store; a dirty store never blocks a worker's stop. KYO-128: `--subagent-stop` reads the SubagentStop payload on stdin and audits the worktree the stopping worker was dispatched into, because a SubagentStop hook inherits the orchestrator session's working directory. When the payload cannot be resolved to exactly one running dispatch, it names the tree it fell back to and exits 0, because a block the woken worker cannot clear costs tokens on every wake and fixes nothing. A tracked path that git status flags counts only if its content differs from HEAD; untracked paths always count. The PATH guard in front of the command is described in session-start.json's comment.
hooks.command: command -v kyo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; c="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; { [ -n "$c" ] && { [ -e "${c%/*}/kyosei/config.yml" ] || [ -e "${c%/*}/.kyosei" ]; }; } || while [ ! -e "$d/kyosei/config.yml" ] && [ ! -e "$d/.kyosei" ]; do case "$d" in */*) d="${d%/*}" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; done; echo 'Kyosei CLI (kyo) is not on PATH, so this hook did not run. Install it: uv tool install kyosei (or pipx install kyosei), then start a new session' >&2; exit 127; }; kyo check-clean --subagent-stop

hooks.comment: KYO-13.c5: the second SubagentStop check, beside the uncommitted-work check above. `kyo check-branch` diffs the current branch and fails (exit 2, shown to the worker) if anything under kyosei/ or ideas/ changed, the two directories a worker's worktree has no legitimate write path into. That is the in-repo half of what defaults/procedures.md's store-write rule promises, in the ledger's current words: 'kyo check-branch (src/kyosei/cmd_guard.py), which the SubagentStop hook invokes at every worker stop', giving 'exit 2 on a branch that diffs anything under kyosei/ or ideas/ relative to its merge-base with main'. KYO-103: tests/test_hook_templates_sync.py (in Kyosei's own repository) compares those two quotations against the ledger, so this comment cannot keep presenting a wording the ledger has dropped. KYO-54: in-repo, this is the only check between a worker branch and the store; under the split layout the store is in its own repository, the guarded diff cannot occur here, and the check is a backstop; with no store configured it exits 0 and says it guards nothing. KYO-128: `--subagent-stop` points it at the stopping worker's own worktree, resolved from the hook payload as for the check above, and an unresolvable stop names the tree it read and does not block. KYO-285: when the stop resolves to one running dispatch, the comparison is against the merge-base of the worker's branch and that dispatch's recorded base sha; `--against main` is the fallback for a stop that cannot be matched. The PATH guard in front of the command is described in session-start.json's comment.
hooks.command: command -v kyo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; c="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; { [ -n "$c" ] && { [ -e "${c%/*}/kyosei/config.yml" ] || [ -e "${c%/*}/.kyosei" ]; }; } || while [ ! -e "$d/kyosei/config.yml" ] && [ ! -e "$d/.kyosei" ]; do case "$d" in */*) d="${d%/*}" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; done; echo 'Kyosei CLI (kyo) is not on PATH, so this hook did not run. Install it: uv tool install kyosei (or pipx install kyosei), then start a new session' >&2; exit 127; }; kyo check-branch --subagent-stop --against main
